bio.text: Joe Polletta, a Republican, has represented District 68 in the Connecticut House of Representatives since May 1, 2017, and is on the November 2026 ballot for re-election.
He earned a political science degree at Fairfield University, owned a local small business and served on the Watertown Town Council.
He was first elected to the seat in a 2017 special election; the district includes Watertown, Oakville and Woodbury.
